maskedValue.$description: MaskedValue's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--masked-value-<name>) on the page, a container or one MaskedValue, and every MaskedValue inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

gap.$description: Between the value and the Show button (4px).
